title: introduce-ghostpage-coalescer-and-eviction-latency-bias-controller
author: Priya Narayanan
description: Context: Live production workloads show recurring memory fragmentation in the KV cache for variable-length token blobs (prompt histories, embeddings). Fragmentation leads to premature spillover to disk and occasional tail-latency regressions during aggressive eviction cycles. Motivation: reduce fragmentation-induced spill and smooth eviction-related latency spikes without increasing average latencies or hurting throughput. What this PR does: 1) Implements a GhostPage Coalescer that tracks underutilized page fragments (ghost entries) across tenants and opportunistically consolidates them into compact pages during low-CPU windows. The tracker maintains a short-lived hitless counter and a size histogram to identify safe consolidation candidates. 2) Adds an Eviction Latency Bias controller: an eviction policy weight that biases selection toward pages whose eviction has historically low downstream latency impact. This uses a lightweight moving quantile of downstream request latency to prioritize low-impact evictions during contention. 3) Introduces a Soft-Spill controller (hysteresis): when memory pressure is transient, instead of immediately spilling to disk or remote storage, we perform bounded in-memory compaction passes and lease short-term overcommit with a grace TTL to reduce oscillation. 4) Kernel-friendly consolidation hooks: small hot-path changes to the allocation kernel to expose coalescing hints (coalesce_hint) and a consolidation callback that the runtime scheduler can call when CPU and GPU stalls are minimal. 5) Scheduler integration and continuous batching awareness: the coalescer is integrated with the request scheduler so consolidation runs are deferred to batching lull windows to avoid interfering with critical request processing. Tests and validation: - Unit tests for ghost tracking, histogram logic, and eviction weight calculations. - Integration test that injects synthetic fragmentation patterns and verifies no regressions in correctness. - End-to-end benchmark on cs-sim cluster with mixed chat+embedding workload. Results: - Fragmentation index decreased by ~18% on the benchmark workload. - Disk spill events reduced by ~34% under the same load profile. - 99th percentile response latency reduced from 420ms -> 310ms in peak contention tests. - No observable throughput loss (TP95 stable within 2%). Backwards compatibility and safety: the feature is guarded by runtime flags: KV_GHOSTPAGE_ENABLED (default true for staging, false for older release channels) and EVICTION_LATENCY_BIAS (defaults to conservative weight 0.2). Safety guards include: per-tenant consolidation quotas, maximum consolidation CPU ms per node, and immediate abort if allocator lock contention exceeds threshold. Checklist: - [x] Design doc attached in PR description - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Load benchmarks - [x] Feature flags and tweaks - [x] Observability metrics added (kv.coalesce.count, kv.coalesce.ms, kv.eviction.bias_score) Related: ENG-2034 (KV fragmentation triage), ENG-2091 (scheduling windows).
commits_summary: Add design doc and initial algorithm notes
Implement GhostPage tracker and histogram state
Add coalescer worker and consolidation callback into allocator
Integrate eviction-latency-bias into evictor selection path
Benchmarks and tuning tweaks based on cs-sim results
changed_snippets: src/kv/ghost_coalescer.rs: added GhostEntry { tenant_id, page_id, free_bytes, last_hit_count } and histogram logic for size buckets
src/scheduler/evictor.rs: eviction candidates now include bias_score = recent_latency_quantile(0.9) * weight + fragmentation_score
runtime/kernel_tuner.py: exported coalesce_hint(page_id) to hint allocator for consolidation
review_conversation: Ethan Zhao: Are we confident the ghost counters won't cause undue memory overhead for very large tenant counts? Suggest bounded map with LRU discard.
Priya Narayanan: Implemented a bounded shard map with LRU eviction (see commit 3). Max overhead capped at 64 bytes * tracked_pages_per_shard.
Maya Patel: Concerned about lock contention in allocator during consolidation. Can we do lock-free snapshotting?
Priya Narayanan: We changed consolidation to work on a copied page-list snapshot and perform copy-on-write merging to avoid long-held allocator locks. See allocator_kernel.rs changes.
Jonah Reed: CI flaky on integration test: observed one failure due to timing of consolidation during batch window. Please add jitter and retry.
Priya Narayanan: Added randomized backoff and retry; re-ran benchmarks and updated thresholds.

release_notes: Reduced KV cache fragmentation and spill events by introducing GhostPage Coalescer and an eviction latency bias controller; p99 tail latency improvements under contention; feature behind runtime flags for staged rollout.
